title: Greensboro Officer Shoots Man Charging With Knife During Domestic Call
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Greensboro, North Carolina — On June 26, 2024, at approximately 8:28 a.m., officers were dispatched to 2109 Crestridge Road in Greensboro, after a 911 call for service about a domestic situation between Titus Kopp, his grandmother and her daughter. On that morning, the grandmother had gone outside of her home and called 911, telling the dispatcher that Kopp had broken into her home and was ransacking it, and he was threatening to kill her, her daughter and himself. 

When Officer Petruzzi arrived, he saw the grandmother sitting on the curb and she was visibly distraught. She told him that her grandson had been released from jail, broke into her home, and was threatening to kill himself with a knife. When she was asked if her grandson was alone, she told Officer Petruzzi that her daughter was still inside. The grandmother said she could not get back in the home. Officer Petruzzi continued to speak with her, trying to get information as they walked toward the home. 

About midway up the driveway, Kopp ran out of the house with a knife. Kopp said, "I have no intentions of living" as he ran down the stairs toward Officer Petruzzi with the knife raised so the point was facing the officer. Officer Petruzzi asked Kopp to put down the knife. Kopp continued coming toward Officer Petruzzi with the knife raised. Officer Petruzzi discharged his weapon twice, striking Kopp. He immediately went to Kopp's side to render aid. Kopp was transported to the hospital but died from his injuries. A silver "Farberware" knife was located on the driveway.
